meta.name: Out of Love Hindi Bengali
meta.description: Meera begins to suspect every female associate of Akarsh, her husband after she found a stray hair which is not hers. After discussing with her friend, she thought she might be over reactive but does not stop digging up for finding the evidence.

videos.title: The Seed
videos.overview: Dr. Meera Kapoor's picture of a perfect marriage turns hazy when she suspects her husband Akarsh of having an affair. Is he?

videos.title: The Outsider
videos.overview: Startling revelations unravel, which make Meera question not just Akarsh, but even her friends and family.

videos.title: More Than Meets The Eye
videos.overview: Under the facade of normalcy, Meera decides to find the truth at any cost. However, a tragedy leaves her with mixed emotions.

videos.title: A Second Chance?
videos.overview: Just when Meera decides to give Akarsh a second chance, her professional life comes crashing down. Pushed beyond her limits, will she pull through?

videos.title: Stop at Nothing
videos.overview: The Kapoors and Kashyaps sit through an awkward dinner. With fire in her eyes and resolve in her mind, will Meera tie all the loose ends?
